documents.content:
SCOPE: 12-month major service per OEM schedule (VTM-110 rev 5). All work performed
with turbine in safe mode, rotor locked, and LOTO applied per SOP-114.

TASKS PERFORMED
1. Hydraulic system: Full pressure test at 185 bar, held 30 min, no drop. Replaced
   two accumulator bladders (p/n 29173331). Torque checked on all high-pressure
   fittings, one M24 stud replaced on yaw brake caliper (thread damage).
2. Gearbox oil: Drained, flushed, replaced with 220L Mobilgear SHC XMP 320.
   Oil sample taken for lab analysis (sample ID GBO-0115-01). Magnetic plug
   inspected – fine metallic sludge noted, within normal wear limits.
3. Main bearing grease: Regreased per OEM interval (2.2 kg per side). Grease
   gun pressure verified at 400 bar. Old grease purged from drain ports.
4. Pitch system: Battery backup test passed (all 3 pitch cylinders cycled
   through full stroke on battery power). Pitch bearing grease lines checked,
   one split ferrule replaced on blade 2 (p/n 10178344).
5. Generator: Bearing greased (1.5 kg, SKF LGHP 2). Slip ring brushes replaced
   (set of 6, p/n 29173331). Insulation resistance tested at 500V – all phases
   > 20 MΩ.
6. Cooling system: Radiator fins blown out with compressed air. Coolant level
   topped up (50/50 glycol mix, 2L). Fan belt tension checked, within spec.
7. Yaw system: Yaw gear teeth inspected – no pitting or spalling found. Yaw
   brake pads measured, 80% remaining, no replacement needed. Yaw drive oil
   topped up (1L, ISO VG 220).
8. Tower bolts: Torque checked on 15% of tower flange bolts (36 of 240) per
   OEM sampling plan. All within tolerance, no re-torque required.
9. Nacelle and hub: Interior cleaned, all emergency stops tested, fire
   suppression system pressure verified (green zone). Escape rope inspected,
   no damage.
10. Blade inspection: Visual inspection of all 3 blades from hub (no rope
    access required this cycle). Blade 1 leading edge erosion noted – minor,
    scheduled for repair at next 6-month inspection. Blade 3 lightning receptor
    replaced (p/n 10237716) – old one had pitting.
